label: SaveThem
description: Plan the optimal route for a messenger to reach the city of Skolwin on a 10×10 terrain grid within fuel and food limits.

steps.label: Discover tools
steps.detail: Use toolsearch to find map, vehicle, and movement-rules tools

steps.label: Fetch data
steps.detail: Call discovered tools to get raw map, vehicle list, and terrain rules

steps.label: Extract structure
steps.detail: Use LLM to parse raw JSON into typed MapGrid, Vehicle[], and MovementRules

steps.label: BFS pathfinding
steps.detail: Run BFS over (row, col, fuel, food, onFoot) state space for each vehicle

steps.label: Submit route
steps.detail: POST optimal [vehicle, dir, dir, ...] answer to /verify as task savethem
